Package org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr

Class Atom

java.lang.Object
org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr.Datum
org.rapidcow.trivnote.libexpr.Atom
Direct Known Subclasses:
Scalar, Symbol
public abstract sealed class Atom extends Datum permits Scalar, Symbol
A non-nil terminal Datum. Concretely, it covers two types of atoms:
  • The Scalar, which holds a quoted string, a number, or a boolean.
  • The Symbol, which holds unquoted strings, usually from a fixed pool of keyword vocabulary.

An atom’s value is a free-form Unicode string, represented by value().

      public abstract String value()
